title: Universal Declaration, Article 18: thought, conscience, and religion, including the freedom to change belief
summary: The United Nations text of Article 18, from the declaration proclaimed on 10 December 1948.
body: The United Nations page of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights gives Article 18. In short: Everyone has the right to freedom of thought, conscience and religion, including the freedom to change religion or belief, and to manifest it alone or with others, in public or private, in teaching, practice, worship, and observance. The core pack records the proclamation and Article 1. This card is Article 18. The declaration is what the General Assembly proclaimed as a common standard. The UN page opened here does not describe it as a treaty that states ratify.

sources.title: Universal Declaration of Human Rights
